method: Each original skill was classified by whether its deliverable or workflow produces or shapes something a person perceives or interacts with (UI, web page, app, published content, media, user-facing flow). Purely machine-facing skills (APIs, database schemas, infrastructure, CLI tooling, internal process) are not-applicable and carry a recorded reason. A skill is applicable only when accessibility guidance specific to its subject exists; see ai/quality/ACCESSIBILITY-COVERAGE.md for the full method.

guidance_values.subsection: Skill must carry a ### Accessibility subsection in Implementation Standards.
guidance_values.whole-skill: The skill itself is accessibility guidance; no subsection required.
guidance_values.none: No accessibility guidance required; a recorded reason justifies the classification.
